source_description_html:
The Bilt Techno 3 helmet is a cutting-edge choice for motorcycle enthusiasts, boasting an aggressive injection molded polycarbonate shell design that enhances both aerodynamics and stability on the road. Available in two shell sizes for a precise fit, it features a quick-release double sprung face shield system and a center lock face shield with turbulators, ensuring a snug fit and optimized airflow. The helmet prioritizes safety with DOT certification and a double D-ring closure system, while also integrating advanced features like a Sena DWO-6 Bluetooth v4.1 system. This allows for up to 4-way intercom support, voice-operated phone and intercom communication, automatic audio boost in noisy environments, music sharing and compatibility with Sena Remote Control devices for seamless management.

In addition to its safety and communication features, the Bilt Techno 3 helmet enhances the riding experience with practical amenities such as a drop-down sun visor to reduce glare and eyeglass-compatible cheek pads for added comfort. With a maximum intercom distance of up to 1000m (0.6 miles), 8 hours of talk time and 7-day stand-by time, riders can enjoy uninterrupted connectivity on their journeys. The helmet also offers smartphone app support for further customization, cementing its status as a versatile and reliable companion for riders seeking both safety and convenience on the open road.

Features:

  • Sporty, full face helmet with integrated Sena Bluetooth
  • Aggressive hawksbill shape for the full tuck
  • Streamlined top vents and rear spoiler to help stability at speed
  • 4 active intake vents, chin vent flows to face and shield and 1 passive exhaust vent under the rear spoiler
  • Injection molded full face polycarbonate shell
  • Aerodynamic shell slices through the wind while maintaining stability
  • 2 shell sizes: XS-MD / LG-2XL
  • Drop-down tinted sun visor
    • Rod actuated for smoother / consistent movement
    • Trigger is behind the left shield release
  • Double gasket seal at base of face shield
  • Removable chin skirt included

Shield:

  • Flat shield design is more optically correct
  • Quick release double sprung face shield system to pull shield tight to gasket
  • Center lock face shield with turbulators to help release the airflow from the helmet

Comfort:

  • Eyeglass-compatible cheek pads to accommodate most eyeglasses

Safety:

  • DOT approved
  • Double D-ring safety retention system

Bluetooth:

  • Integrated Sena DWO-6 Bluetooth v4.1 system
  • WAVE Intercom compatibility eliminates distance and device limitations:
    • Connects riders using any brand of Bluetooth or Mesh comm system (read more) 
    • Wave App is free and available on the Google Play Store or Apple Itunes
  • Up to 4-way intercom support
  • Voice operated phone and intercom communication
  • Automatic audio boost in noisy environments
  • Music sharing
  • Max intercom distance of up to 1000m (0.6 miles)
  • Up to 8 hour talk time w/ 7 day stand-by time
  • Smartphone app supported
  • Compatible with Sena Remote Control devices (sold separately)
